findings.reason: the interface accounts in this plan are load-bearing for reviewers and for the nodes' declared write scopes, and an account that omits an added public symbol misled nothing yet but will not match the section's delivered surface.
findings.text: §7 states "The section's interface change is the pin table below, which retires three public constants and their re-export", but the psi-store node the changed comment records as landed added `write_geqdsk_store` (public, in `imas_ambix/data/geqdsk_store.py` `__all__`), a second public addition beside the pin table and the resolver already enumerated in this section, so the section-level interface account is now understated

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `imas_ambix/data/geqdsk_store.py` `write_geqdsk_store`, `imas_ambix/challenge/loader.py` `load_geqdsk`, `tests/data/test_geqdsk_store.py` and the rule `equilibrium_psi` all exist as claimed; the psi rule carries `psi_like`, `source_cocos=1` and `source_group=GEQDSK`, matching the comment.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — the section's done-when names a measurable floor (boundary RMS < 0.10 m; psi NRMS < 1% of the flux range) and a must-fail control for both the stamp and the psi check (plan.html:627-640), and the landed psi rule reproduces a failing flipped arm (0.146 vs the 1% bound).
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the changed units cite repository files, four resolving commits (88d302b4, eba48b28, 96adf113, 95388a50 all `git cat-file -t` = commit) and `maps/jt-60sa/maps/equilibrium.json`, which resolves in the main checkout; no session-scratchpad or node-local path appears in the changed units.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the changed units carry no plan labels, stage names, ticket numbers or version tags into code, and state mechanism (staging layout, rule factor) rather than changelog prose.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — the section's stated interface account (plan.html:312) claims the pin table is the section's interface change, but the psi-store landing the changed unit records added the public `write_geqdsk_store`, so the account is incomplete.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — each §7 node carries one deliverable, and the psi store is a single staging-and-binding node.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — the psi store, the SELENE PSRC reader, the reference loader and the equilibrium binding are ordered consistently with the §8 execution order (plan.html:660-663) and with the pin-table/registry/selection sequence (plan.html:428, :503-507).
